### 2026-10-12 – THIS TOOK ME SO MUCH LONGER THAN IT SHOULD HAVE!!!!!!!!

**1.2h**

THIS TOOK ME SO MUCH LONGER THAN IT SHOULD HAVE!!!!!!!!
I got the Nike Mind's shape on the sides perfectly and matched it to my shoe size!!! I still need to round it out so it looks good in the front and back. I want to TRY to make TPU bubbles so that you still have a genuine Nike Mind feel, but I can just seperately design those and then glue them onto the shoe, so that's fine.
